blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: An offline language-based support tool is presented to assist pilot training and tactical decision-making in air combat operations. The system, named MATE (Mission Assistant for Training and Evaluation), applies retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) to answer natural language questions using content extracted from doctrinal and tactical manuals. Built entirely with open-source components, it performs text preprocessing, embedding generation, semantic search, and language generation locally, ensuring full offline functionality. The tool was evaluated by three Brazilian Air Force fighter pilots, who rated the answers produced with three open-weight language models (Llama 3.1 8B, Qwen 2.5 14B, and Mistral NeMo 12B) to five tactical questions derived from a publicly available air combat manual. Average ratings ranged from 4.00 to 4.40 on a five-point scale, with Mistral NeMo 12B obtaining the highest score, and the pilots rated the response time of the tool as fully adequate compared to manual search. The relevance of the retrieved content was identified as the main point for improvement. Potential applications are discussed in onboard mission systems, flight simulators, and training environments.
blocks.zh: 提供了一个基于语言的离线支助工具,以协助空中作战行动的试点培训和战术决策。 该系统名为MATE(特派团培训和评价助理),采用检索辅助生成(RAG)方法,利用从理论和战术手册中提取的内容回答自然语言问题。 它完全由开源组件所建,它执行文本预处理,嵌入生成,语义搜索,以及本地语言生成,确保全线下功能. 该工具被三名巴西空军战斗机飞行员评价,他们将使用三种开放量级语言模型(Llama 3.1 8B,Quen 2.5 14B,和Mistral NeMo 12B)生成的答案评为出自于公开的空战手册的五个战术问题. 平均收视率从4:00到4.40不等,分数为5分,Mistral NeMo 12B获得最高分数,与人工搜索相比,飞行员将工具的响应时间评为完全充分. 检索内容的相关性被确定为需要改进的要点。 潜在的应用在飞行任务系统、飞行模拟器和培训环境中讨论。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Air combat missions often require fast and reliable access to tactical information that is usually found in lengthy and complex manuals. During planning or even in flight, pilots and mission planners may need to consult this content quickly. However, doing so manually is often slow and impractical, especially in environments where internet access is not available or allowed. The ability to interact with technical documents in a natural and efficient way is increasingly valuable in defense contexts ( Doll et al., 2024 ) .
blocks.zh: 空中作战任务往往需要快速可靠地获取战术信息,这些通常在冗长而复杂的手册中找到. 在计划期间甚至飞行中,飞行员和任务规划人员可能需要迅速查阅这一内容. 然而,人工操作常常是缓慢和不切实际的,特别是在无法或不允许使用互联网的环境中。 以自然和有效的方式与技术文件互动的能力在国防背景下越来越重要(Doll等人,2024年)。

blocks.en: Recent progress in natural language processing (NLP), especially with large language models (LLMs), has made it possible to build systems that answer user questions in plain language using information from documents ( Brown et al., 2020 ; OpenAI, 2023 ) . However, most of these tools depend on cloud services, which limits their use in sensitive or disconnected environments such as military aircraft or secure simulators.
blocks.zh: 自然语言处理(NLP)的近期进展,特别是大语言模型(LLM),使得使用文档信息构建简单语言回答用户问题的系统成为可能(Brown等人,2020年;OpenAI,2023年). 然而,这些工具大多依赖于云服务,这限制了它们在敏感或断开的环境下的使用,如军用飞机或安全模拟器.

blocks.en: To address this gap, we present an offline language-based support tool that uses retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) ( Lewis et al., 2020 ) to provide helpful answers based on doctrinal manuals. The system combines document search with a local language model, allowing users to ask questions in natural language and receive relevant, context-aware answers. It is built entirely with open-source tools and works fully offline, making it suitable for use in onboard systems, simulators, and training environments. The system is modular and can be adapted to different types of documents.
blocks.zh: 为了弥补这一差距,我们提出了一个基于语言的离线支持工具,该工具使用检索辅助生成(RAG)(Lewis等人,2020年),根据理论手册提供有益的答案。 该系统将文档搜索与本地语言模式相结合,允许用户用自然语言提问,并获得相关,有上下文意识的答案. 它完全用开源工具建造,工作完全离线,使其适合用于机载系统,模拟器,和训练环境. 该系统是模块化的,可以适应不同类型的文档.

blocks.en: The main contribution of this work is the design and implementation of a tactical tool that runs completely offline and helps users access sensitive documents that should not be processed online. We show how it works using real examples from air combat manuals and explain how it can support decision-making and training in air combat situations. We also report an expert validation in which Brazilian Air Force fighter pilots rated the quality of the answers produced by the tool with three different open-weight language models.
blocks.zh: 这项工作的主要贡献是设计和实施一个完全离线运行的战术工具,帮助用户访问不应在线处理的敏感文件. 我们用空中作战手册中的真正例子来说明它是如何工作的,并解释它如何能够支持空中作战情况下的决策和培训。 我们还报告了一项专家鉴定,其中巴西空军战斗机飞行员用三种不同的开放量级语言模型,对工具生成的答案的质量进行了评级.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: NLP has been increasingly applied in military contexts to enhance decision-making, intelligence analysis, and operational efficiency ( Teže and Nazaruka, 2024 ) . Early initiatives, such as DARPA’s TIPSTER program, aimed to improve information retrieval and extraction for defense applications, laying the groundwork for subsequent advancements in military NLP systems ( Defense Advanced Research Projects Agency, 1991 ) .
blocks.zh: NLP越来越多地用于军事背景,以加强决策、情报分析和行动效率(Teže和Nazaruka,2024年)。 早期举措,例如DARPA的TIPSTER方案,旨在改善用于国防应用的信息检索和提取,为军事NLP系统随后的进步奠定基础(国防高级研究项目局,1991年)。

blocks.en: Recent developments have seen the integration of NLP in various military operations. For instance, DARPA’s Transformative Apps (TransApps) program developed and rapidly fielded secure mobile applications for deployed military units, showing how software tools can be delivered directly to field operations ( Defense Advanced Research Projects Agency, 2010 ) . Similarly, the MiTAP system, developed by the Mitre Corporation, utilizes NLP to gather, translate, and present information for monitoring global events, aiding in biosecurity and defense intelligence ( Damianos et al., 2002 ) .
blocks.zh: 最近的事态发展表明,NLP已融入各种军事行动。 例如,DARPA的变形Apps(TransApps)程序为部署的军事单位开发并迅速部署安全移动应用程序,显示软件工具如何直接交付给外地行动(国防高级研究项目局,2010年)。 同样,Mitre公司开发的MITAP系统利用NLP收集、翻译和提交信息,以监测全球事件,协助生物安保和国防情报(Damianos等人,2002年)。

blocks.en: In the field of intelligence analysis, NLP has been employed to process vast amounts of unstructured data. Primer, an AI company, has developed NLP tools for the U.S. Special Operations Command to analyze and identify disinformation campaigns, showcasing the role of NLP in modern information warfare ( Knight, 2020 ) . Additionally, the COA-GPT model employs large language models to generate courses of action in military operations, highlighting the potential of NLP in strategic planning ( Goecks and Waytowich, 2024 ) .
blocks.zh: 在情报分析领域,NLP被用于处理大量无结构的数据. AI公司Primer为美国特种作战司令部开发了NLP工具,用于分析和识别虚假宣传,展示NLP在现代信息战中的作用(Knight,2020). 此外,COA-GPT模式采用大型语言模式,以产生军事行动中的行动方案,突出NLP在战略规划中的潜力(Goecks and Waytowich, 2024年)。

blocks.en: Applications of AI and language interfaces in air combat have also been explored. For example, the Air Combat Evolution (ACE) program by DARPA aims to develop collaboration between AI and human pilots, allowing pilots to act as “battle managers” for unmanned aircraft ( Halpern, 2022 ) . Moreover, speech recognition systems have been implemented in advanced fighter aircraft, such as the F-35 Lightning II, to allow pilots to manage subsystems such as communications and navigation by voice, thereby reducing pilot workload ( Schutte, 2007 ) .
blocks.zh: 还探讨了AI和语言界面在空战中的应用. 例如,DARPA的空中战斗进化(ACE)方案旨在发展AI和人类飞行员之间的合作,使飞行员能够担任无人驾驶飞机的“战斗管理者”(Halpern, 2022年)。 此外,在F-35闪电II等高级战斗机上也采用了语音识别系统,使飞行员能够通过语音管理通信和导航等子系统,从而减少飞行员的工作量(Schutte,2007年).

blocks.en: 3 Methodology
blocks.zh: 3 方法

blocks.en: The proposed system, MATE (Mission Assistant for Training and Evaluation), is designed to provide offline, natural language access to tactical knowledge by combining document retrieval and generative language modeling. It follows a modular architecture with five key elements: document indexing, semantic retrieval, language model interaction, user interface, and offline deployment.
blocks.zh: 拟议的系统MATE(特派团培训和评价助理)旨在将文件检索和基因语言建模结合起来,提供离线自然语言获取战术知识的机会。 它遵循模块化架构,包含五个关键要素:文档索引,语义检索,语言模型交互,用户界面,以及离线部署.

blocks.en: Document Indexing: The pipeline starts by preprocessing and indexing doctrinal and tactical manuals stored locally. Supported formats (.txt, .pdf, .docx) are converted into plain text and split into overlapping segments of 1,200 characters, with an overlap of 250 characters between consecutive segments. The multilingual paraphrase-multilingual-MiniLM-L12-v2 model from SentenceTransformers ( Reimers and Gurevych, 2019 ; Reimers and Gurevych, 2020 ) encodes each segment into a 384-dimensional embedding. The embeddings are L2-normalized and stored in a FAISS inner-product index ( Johnson et al., 2021 ) , so that the similarity search corresponds to cosine similarity. A metadata file links each segment to its source document.
blocks.zh: 文档索引 : 管道首先对储存在当地的理论和战术手册进行预处理和索引。 支持的格式(.txt,.pdf,.docx)被转换成纯文本,分为1200个字符的重叠段,连续段之间重叠250个字符. 多语种配音-多语种-MiniLM-L12-v2模式来自PrimeTransfers(Reimers and Gurevich, 2019; Reimers and Gurevych, 2020),将每个段编码为384维嵌入. 嵌入物是L2-正态化的,并存储在FAISS内产物指数(Johnson等人,2021年)中,这样相似性搜索就与余弦相似. 一个元数据文件将每个部分链接到它的源文档.

blocks.en: Semantic Retrieval: When a user submits a natural language question, the system computes its embedding using the same model and performs a nearest-neighbor search over the FAISS index. The top- k k most similar segments ( k = 5 k=5 ) are selected and concatenated, in order of similarity, into a textual context limited to 4,000 characters, which is passed as input to the language model together with the question. All retrieval logic is implemented in Python using the FAISS and SentenceTransformers libraries.
blocks.zh: 语义检索: 当用户提交自然语言问题时,系统会使用同一模型计算其嵌入,并在FAISS索引上进行近邻搜索. 顶- k k 最相似的片段( k = 5 k = 5 ) 被选择和调和,按相似性的顺序排列,形成一个限定为4000个字符的文字上下文,作为输入语言模型和问题一起传递. 所有检索逻辑在Python中使用FAISS和句子Transfers库实现.

blocks.en: Language Model Interaction: The context and user query are forwarded to a locally deployed LLM via the Ollama API ( Ollama, 2023 ) , which handles model loading, memory management, and inference entirely offline. Any open-weight model available in Ollama can be used; in this work, the tool was evaluated with Llama 3.1 8B ( Grattafiori et al., 2024 ) , Qwen 2.5 14B ( Qwen Team, 2024 ) , and Mistral NeMo 12B ( Mistral AI, 2024 ) . A FastAPI ( Ramírez, 2018 ) backend handles requests from the interface or external applications, builds the prompt from a system instruction, the retrieved context, and the user’s question, and streams the generated response back to the interface. In the evaluation reported in Section 4 , the system instruction asked the model to answer directly and concisely, based strictly on the reference chapter, using standard aviation terminology, and to state explicitly when a question fell outside the scope of the chapter.
blocks.zh: 语言模型交互 : 上下文和用户查询通过Ollama API(Ollama, 2023)传输到本地部署的LLM,该API处理模型加载,内存管理,推论完全离线. Ollama中的任何开放量级模型都可以使用;在这部作品中,该工具被评价为Llama 3.1 8B(Grattafiori等人,2024年),Quen 2.5 14B(Quen Team,2024年),以及Mistral NeMo 12B(Mistral AI,2024年). A FastAPI(Ramírez,2018年)后端处理来自界面或外部应用程序的请求,构建了系统指令的提示,检索上下文,以及用户的问题,以及生成的回复流回界面. 在第4节中所报告的评价中,系统指示要求模型直接和简明地回答,严格根据参考章节,使用标准航空术语,并明确说明一个问题何时不属于该章节的范围。

blocks.en: User Interface: The interface is built using Tkinter ( Python Software Foundation, 2024 ) , a lightweight GUI library for Python. It allows users to type questions in natural language and receive AI-generated answers in real time, with a selector for the installed language models, Ask, Clear, and Stop controls, keyboard shortcuts, and error handling. All interactions with the backend occur through HTTP requests to the local FastAPI server. An optional voice input module based on Whisper ( Radford et al., 2023 ) and PyAudio is also available, but it was disabled during the evaluation reported in Section 4 . Figure 1 shows a screenshot of the user interface, where the assistant answers a tactical question using doctrinal content offline.
blocks.zh: 用户界面:接口使用Tkinter(Python Software Foundation, 2024)构建,是Python的轻量级GUI库. 它允许用户用自然语言输入问题,并实时接收AI生成的答案,同时为安装的语言模型,Ask,Clear,以及Stop控件,键盘快捷键,以及错误处理设置一个选择器. 所有与后端的交互都通过HTTP请求发生到本地FastAPI服务器. 还有一个基于Whisper(Radford等人,2023年)和PyAudio的可选语音输入模块,但在第4节报道的评价中被禁用. 图1显示用户界面的截图,其中助理使用理论内容离线回答战术问题.

blocks.en: Figure 1: Screenshot of the MATE graphical interface.
blocks.zh: 图1:MATE图形界面的屏幕截图.

blocks.en: Offline Deployment: All components are designed to run entirely offline, supporting use in air-gapped environments. The embedding model, FAISS index, and the language model are all stored locally. The system can be packaged using tools like PyInstaller ( PyInstaller Development Team, 2025 ) to create a standalone executable, and no internet connection is required at runtime. This ensures suitability for sensitive or classified military applications. Figure 2 summarizes the overall architecture and data flow of the system, showing how user queries are processed through semantic retrieval and local language generation.
blocks.zh: 离线部署: 所有组件都设计为完全离线运行,支持在空气加载环境中的使用. 嵌入式模型,FAISS索引,以及语言模型都在当地存储. 系统可以使用PyInstaller(PyInstaller Development Team,2025)等工具进行包装,以创建独立的可执行文件,运行时不需要互联网连接. 这可确保适合敏感或机密的军事应用。 图2总结了系统的整体结构和数据流,显示了用户查询是如何通过语义检索和本地语言生成处理的.

blocks.en: Figure 2: Overview of the offline tactical assistant system architecture.
blocks.zh: 图 2:离线战术助理系统架构概述.

blocks.en: 4 Expert Validation
blocks.zh: 4 专家鉴定

blocks.en: To assess whether the proposed system can support tactical decision-making, an evaluation was conducted with Brazilian Air Force fighter pilots. As we cannot include or disclose classified military documents in this study, the knowledge base was built from a publicly available reference: Chapter 5, “Section Tactics: Two-versus-One”, of Robert L. Shaw’s manual “Fighter Combat: Tactics and Maneuvering” ( Shaw, 1985 ) . This chapter provides comprehensive descriptions of section-level tactics, two-versus-one engagements, and the tactical principles relevant to the evaluation.
blocks.zh: 为了评估拟议的系统能否支持战术决策,与巴西空军战斗机飞行员进行了评估。 由于我们无法在这项研究中包括或披露机密军事文件,知识库是根据公开的参考资料建立起来的:罗伯特·肖的手册《战斗:战术和机动》第5章, " 战术部分:二对一 " (Shaw,1985年)。 本章全面描述了科级战术,二战对一交战,以及与评价相关的战术原则.

blocks.en: Five questions were derived from the chapter to reflect typical queries a pilot or mission planner might have. They cover the benefits of mutual support and the evolution of section doctrine, from the Fighting Wing to the Double Attack and the Loose Deuce:
blocks.zh: 本章提出了五个问题,以反映飞行员或特派团规划人员可能提出的典型问题。 它们包括相互支持的好处以及从战斗翼到双倍攻击和Loose Duce的科系理论的演变:

blocks.en: Q1: What is the primary advantage of flying as a section instead of a single fighter? Q2: What are the main advantages of the Fighting Wing formation for new pilots? Q3: What are the main weaknesses of the Fighting Wing doctrine? Q4: What tactical innovation did the Double Attack introduce compared to Fighting Wing? Q5: How does the Loose Deuce differ from the Double Attack in offensive engagement?
blocks.zh: 问题1:飞行作为一节而非单战斗机的主要优势是什么? 问题2:战斗翼阵容对新飞行员的主要优势是什么?. 问题3:战斗翼学说的主要弱点是什么? 问题4:"双击"与"战斗翼"相比引入了何种战术创新. 问题5:在进攻性交战中,Louse Duce号与"双攻"号有何不同?.

blocks.en: What is the primary advantage of flying as a section instead of a single fighter?
blocks.zh: 作为一节飞行而不是单战斗机的主要优势是什么?

blocks.en: What are the main advantages of the Fighting Wing formation for new pilots?
blocks.zh: 战斗翼阵容对新飞行员的主要优势是什么?.

blocks.en: What are the main weaknesses of the Fighting Wing doctrine?
blocks.zh: 战斗翼学说的主要弱点是什么?

blocks.en: What tactical innovation did the Double Attack introduce compared to Fighting Wing?
blocks.zh: 与"战斗翼"相比,"双重进攻"引入了何种战术创新?.

blocks.en: How does the Loose Deuce differ from the Double Attack in offensive engagement?
blocks.zh: 在进攻性交战中,Louse Duce号与双人攻击号有何不同?

blocks.en: Each question was submitted to the tool three times, once with each of the evaluated models, using the same indexed chapter and retrieval pipeline. The evaluation then followed three steps:
blocks.zh: 每个问题三次提交工具,一次与每个被评价的模型,使用相同的索引章节和检索管道。 然后,评价采取了三个步骤:

blocks.en: 1) Participant Profile : Each pilot reported their operational experience, flight hours, and familiarity with LLMs. 2) Tactical Evaluation : Each pilot rated the 15 answers (five questions, three models) on a 5-point Likert scale ( Boone and Boone, 2012 ) , from 1 (very inadequate) to 5 (very adequate). 3) General Evaluation : Each pilot rated five tool-level aspects on the same scale and could leave free-text suggestions.
blocks.zh: 1) 参与者简介:每个飞行员都报告了业务经验、飞行时数和对有限责任公司熟悉程度。 2)战术评价:每个飞行员将15个答案(5个问题,3个模型)评为5分的Ikrt尺度(Boone和Boone,2012年),从1(非常不足)评为5(非常充分)。 3) 总体评价:每个试点对5个工具层面的相同规模进行评级,并可留下自由文本建议。

blocks.en: Participant Profile : Each pilot reported their operational experience, flight hours, and familiarity with LLMs.
blocks.zh: 参与者简介:每个飞行员都报告了业务经验、飞行时数和对有限责任公司熟悉程度。

blocks.en: Tactical Evaluation : Each pilot rated the 15 answers (five questions, three models) on a 5-point Likert scale ( Boone and Boone, 2012 ) , from 1 (very inadequate) to 5 (very adequate).
blocks.zh: 战术评估: 每个飞行员将15个答案(5个问题,3个模型)评为5分的Ikrt尺度(Boone和Boone,2012年),从1(非常不足)评为5(非常充分).

blocks.en: General Evaluation : Each pilot rated five tool-level aspects on the same scale and could leave free-text suggestions.
blocks.zh: 一般评价: 每个试点对5个工具级方面进行同样的评级,并可留下自由文本建议。

blocks.en: The panel consisted of three fighter pilots with, on average, 6.7 years of operational experience and 933 flight hours. They reported moderate familiarity with LLMs (occasional use and basic knowledge), mostly through ChatGPT, Gemini, and Llama.
blocks.zh: 小组由3名战斗机飞行员组成,平均有6.7年的作战经验和933个飞行小时。 他们报告说,他们对LLMS(偶然使用和基本知识)相当熟悉,主要是通过ChatGPT、双子座和Llama。

blocks.zh: 表1:战术问题答案的评分(平均 ±\pm 标准偏差 3 名飞行员, 1–5 级).

blocks.en: Table 2: General evaluation of the tool (mean ± \pm standard deviation over three pilots, 1–5 scale).
blocks.zh: 表2:该工具的一般评价(平均±\pm标准偏差在3个飞行员,1–5比例).

blocks.en: Table 1 shows the ratings of the answers to the tactical questions. All three models produced answers rated as adequate for most questions, with averages between 4.00 and 4.40. Mistral NeMo 12B obtained the highest average, matching or exceeding the other models in every question, while the largest difference between models appeared in Q4, where Llama 3.1 8B received 3.33 and Mistral NeMo 12B received 4.67. Q3, which asks about the weaknesses of the Fighting Wing doctrine, received a rating of 3 from every pilot for every model. Since this pattern does not depend on the model, it more likely reflects the content supplied by the retrieval step than the generation step itself.
blocks.zh: 表1显示战术问题答案的评分. 所有三种模式都给出了被评为足以回答大多数问题的答案,平均在4.00到4.40之间. Mistral NeMo 12B在每个问题中获得了最高的平均值,匹配或超过其他模型,而模型的最大差异出现在Q4,其中Llama 3.1 8B获得3.33,Mistral NeMo 12B获得4.67. Q3质疑"战斗翼"理论的弱点,获得每个飞行员对每个模型的3分评分. 由于这种模式并不依赖于模型,因此比起生成步骤本身,更有可能反映检索步骤提供的内容.

blocks.en: This interpretation is consistent with the general evaluation in Table 2 . The aspects related to retrieval, namely the relevance of the retrieved content and its integration into the answer, received the lowest ratings (3.67), whereas terminological accuracy and clarity were rated 4.33. Response time received the maximum rating from all pilots, indicating that querying the tool is faster than locating the information manually in the reference text. One factor that may affect retrieval is the context limit: with segments of 1,200 characters and a limit of 4,000 characters, only about three of the five retrieved segments reach the model in full, so relevant passages ranked lower may be truncated or left out.
blocks.zh: 这一解释与表2中的一般评价是一致的。 与检索有关的方面,即检索内容的相关性及其与答复的结合,得到的评级最低(3.67),而术语的准确性和清晰度则被评为4.33。 回复时间得到所有飞行员的最高评分,表明查询工具的速度比在参考文本中手动查找信息的速度快. 可能影响检索的一个因素是上下文限制:有1200个字符的区段和4000个字符的限制,五个检索区段中只有大约3个完全到达模型,因此排名较低的相关段落可能被截断或忽略.

blocks.en: These results should be interpreted as exploratory. The panel was small, the questions covered a single chapter of one manual, and the number of answers per model does not support statistical comparisons between models or a meaningful analysis of inter-rater agreement ( Koo and Li, 2016 ) . Nevertheless, they indicate that a fully offline RAG pipeline running on open-weight models can produce answers that experienced fighter pilots consider adequate for most tactical questions, and they point to retrieval as the main component to improve.
blocks.zh: 这些结果应被解释为是探索性的。 面板小,问题涵盖一个手册的单章,每个模型的答案数并不能支持模型之间的统计比较或对端方间协议的有意义的分析(Koo和Li,2016). 尽管如此,他们表示,在开放重量型号上运行的全线下游RAG输油管能够产生出经验丰富的战斗机飞行员认为足以解决大多数战术问题的答案,他们指出回收是改进的主要组成部分.

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion and Future Work
blocks.zh: 5. 结论和今后的工作

blocks.en: This work presented MATE, an offline tactical assistant that combines document retrieval with a local language model to support decision-making and training in air combat operations. The tool allows users to ask questions in natural language and receive answers based on doctrinal manuals, even in environments without internet access. It was built using open-source tools and follows a modular architecture, making it suitable for integration into simulators and mission planning systems.
blocks.zh: 这项工作介绍了MATE,一名离线战术助理,将文件检索与当地语言模式结合起来,以支持空中作战行动的决策和培训。 该工具允许用户用自然语言提问,并获得基于理论手册的答案,即使在没有互联网接入的环境中也是如此. 它使用开源工具建造,并遵循模块化架构,使其适合融入模拟器和任务规划系统.

blocks.en: An evaluation with three Brazilian Air Force fighter pilots showed that the answers produced with three open-weight models were rated as adequate for most tactical questions, with Mistral NeMo 12B obtaining the highest average rating, and that the response time of the tool was considered fully adequate compared to manual search. The lowest ratings were associated with the relevance and integration of the retrieved content.
blocks.zh: 对三名巴西空军战斗机飞行员的评价显示,用三种开放量模型制作的答案被评为足以解决大多数战术问题,Mistral NeMo 12B获得了最高的平均评分,与人工搜索相比,该工具的响应时间被认为是完全充分的. 最低的评分与检索内容的相关性和整合有关。

blocks.en: Future work will focus on five main improvements: broader evaluation , with more pilots, more questions, and additional tactical scenarios and manuals, enabling inter-rater agreement analysis; retrieval quality , improving how manuals are segmented, how relevant passages are selected, and how much context is passed to the model; response time , using more capable hardware to support larger models; interactivity , adding dialogue history to support follow-up questions and integrating the tool with simulation environments; and voice interface , optimizing the voice module, which is currently too heavy for routine use during flight or simulator-based training.
blocks.zh: 今后的工作将侧重于五个主要改进:更广泛的评价,包括更多的飞行员、更多的问题和更多的战术设想和手册,从而能够进行战略间协议分析;检索质量,改进手册的分块方式,如何选择相关段落,以及向模型传递多少背景;答复时间,利用更有能力的硬件支持更大的模型;交互性,增加对话历史,以支持后续问题,并将工具与模拟环境相结合;语音接口,优化语音模块,因为目前在飞行或模拟训练期间,语音模块太重,无法例行使用。

blocks.en: Offline tools like the one presented in this work may eventually help pilots access relevant tactical knowledge during training, operational missions, or post-mission debriefings. Although still in its early stages, this type of system has the potential to serve as a valuable support tool in simulators or onboard aircraft, particularly in air combat operations that demand quick decision-making under high pressure and without reliable connectivity.
blocks.zh: 这项工作中提出的离线工具最终可帮助飞行员在训练、行动任务或任务后汇报期间获得相关的战术知识。 尽管这种系统仍处于初期阶段,但有可能成为模拟器或机载飞机中的宝贵辅助工具,特别是在空中作战行动中,需要高压下快速决策,且没有可靠的连接.

blocks.en: Code Availability
blocks.zh: 代码可用性

blocks.en: The source code of MATE is publicly available at https://github.com/jpadantas/mate . The repository includes the indexing, retrieval, backend, and interface components described in Section 3 , together with the configuration used in the evaluation. The reference manual used in the evaluation is copyrighted and is not distributed with the code.
blocks.zh: MATE的源代码可在https://github.com/jpadantas/mate上公开查阅. 该寄存器包括第3节所述索引、检索、后端和接口组件,以及评价中使用的配置。 评价中使用的参考手册有版权,不随代码一起分发.
